release: Recorded crime at Community Safety Partnership and local authority level
cadence: quarterly, alongside the Crime in England and Wales bulletin
bank: none, this dataset has no fetch or transform script
provenance: Hand-authored and committed in a7bbed2 alongside the five-domain place profiles. There is no fetch or transform script: the 25 rows were transcribed from the year ending March 2024 edition. Rebuilding it from source is an ingest job, and doing so would widen coverage beyond 25 areas, which changes the comparison set for every percentile the pressure index publishes.
manualFields: every row: no generator exists, so nothing regenerates when ONS publishes
blockedOn: no fetch or transform script exists for this dataset, so there is nothing to run. Building one widens coverage past the 25 hand-picked areas, which changes the comparison set behind every pressure-index percentile the site publishes.
